name: Belial
source:
A senior angel who wields a spear. Possessing strength second only to Azazel, he holds a long spear with ease. 

Strangely for an angel, he has a serious personality and pledges allegiance to Azazel. He likes to work out.

A self-proclaimed gentleman who swears he won't lay a hand on a woman. He won't forgive anyone who uses cowardly means.

[Translated from [url=https://warabimochipizzacha.wixsite.com/heavensroyale]official website[/url]]
